name: Reflections: Beyond the Canvas
source:
You're a game art student.

Drawing comes easily to you. Imagining even more so.

Framing scenes. Studying light. Turning fleeting ideas into something real.

But one morning, a new student walks into your classroom.

And she looks exactly like the girl you dreamed about.

Exactly like the one you drew.

That shouldn’t be possible.

[From [url=https://softheartsstudio.itch.io/reflections-beyond]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名游戏艺术专业的学生。

绘画对你来说很容易。想象更是如此。

构图场景。研究光。将转瞬即逝的想法变成现实。

但是有一天早上，一名新学生走进了你的教室。

她看起来和你梦中的那个女孩一模一样。

和你画的一模一样。

那应该是不可能的。

[来自[url=https://softheartsstudio.itch.io/reflections-beyond]itch.io[/url]]
